content.comment_body: Hi, I've created a User Defined Function that operates like a relay, but I'm facing a peculiar issue: the output is triggering even when none of the inputs are active. This happens only during online operation—in simulation, everything works as expected. Could someone advise on what I might be overlooking? UDF attached.
Hello, I'm experiencing the same error—simulation is working, but not in real-world use.
For me, it works in both simulation and on the actual hardware of [product_name]. See attached video.
All inputs need to be connected for proper operation on real hardware. Set Status 0 (Low) instead of leaving an input open. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you! You were correct—grounding the A input resolved the issue and everything is functioning properly now.

analysis.insight_summary: Users noticed discrepancies between how a User Defined Function (UDF) performed in simulation versus actual hardware, with the output activating unexpectedly during real-world use. This difference highlighted the importance of connecting all inputs on physical devices and pointed to gaps between simulated and real hardware behaviors, especially with unconnected inputs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the UDF to behave consistently in both simulation and real-world scenarios, and want outputs to activate only when the corresponding inputs are active. Additionally, they expect clear system logic and feedback throughout the process.
